limitations.description: campaign_sku.csv records campaign-to-SKU links only; per-pair spend/revenue/orders are not available and are left null.
Attribute completion percentage is not computed by any upstream source; the field is left null.
Content score is not computed by any upstream source; the field is left null.
Ozon product/stock enrichment sync failed or has not run for this metric date.
Advertising spend/revenue/orders are tracked at campaign level only; per-SKU attribution is not distributed and is left null.
Per-SKU funnel metrics (impressions, views, add_to_cart) are not tracked; only account-level funnel data is available.
Per-SKU delivered/cancelled/returns breakdown is not tracked; only order count and revenue are available at SKU granularity.
Reserved stock is not tracked as a distinct field; only available and in-transit stock are known.
